title: Qwen3.6-27B Q3_K_M on RX 7800 XT (llama.cpp HIP/ROCm 7.2.3): 549 tok/s prefill, 23.4 tok/s decode
summary: AMD RX 7800 XT (gfx1101, RDNA3). Qwen3.6-27B Q3_K_M. Runtime: llama.cpp (HIP backend, ROCm 7.2.3). Métricas: Prompt processing (pp512): 549.09 tok/s; Text generation (tg128): 23.39 tok/s. Uso: local inference on mid-range AMD discrete GPU; long-context capable. Límite: ROCm setup on Linux; author notes next steps include ROCm vs Vulkan comparison. Por qué importa: Full reproducible stack (Ubuntu 24.04.4 + Kernel 6.17 + ROCm 7.2.3 + HIP build) with exact llama.cpp benchmark numbers on affordable older AMD card. Shows strong prefill performance.
